rows.indiv_sql:
SET @prov_c:=(SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx( PRIMARY KEY (HOSPCODE,PID,BDATE)) ENGINE=MyISam charset=UTF8 IGNORE AS
SELECT
h.hoscode as hospcode, h.hosname, p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA,TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,p.birth,BDATE) age_y
,l.gravida,l.bdate,l.bhosp,l.btype,l.bresult,l.lborn,l.sborn
,IF(gravida >1 ,'ตั้งครรภ์ซ้ำ','ไม่พบประวัติซ้ำ') AS result
FROM	t_labor  l 
		INNER JOIN chospital h ON l.bhosp=h.hoscode AND hostype in(5,6,7,11,12,15)   AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
	INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON l.hospcode=p.hospcode AND l.pid=p.pid 
WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,p.birth,BDATE) < 20 AND l.BDATE BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
 AND p.nation in(99);
SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX
, d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA,d.age_y
,d.gravida,d.bdate,d.bhosp,d.btype,d.bresult,d.lborn,d.sborn,d.result
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}
